title: Admin Web V2 I18n Expansion
problem: Admin Web V2 has an i18n boundary, but only the shell and library-management routes are broadly localized.
gates: cd apps/admin-web && npm run test -- App.test.tsx
Browser smoke for each localized route batch desktop and mobile

evidence.summary: Confirmed the existing i18n provider/catalog/shell boundary and selected /overview plus /access as the first route batch.
Migrated /overview and /access route-visible copy to English and Simplified Chinese message ids, added localized route tests, ran Admin Web gates, and completed desktop/mobile Chinese browser smoke.

Migrated /settings route-visible diagnostics and raw-cache mutation copy to English and Simplified Chinese message ids, added localized route tests, ran Admin Web gates, and completed desktop/mobile Chinese browser smoke.

Migrated /catalog/governance and /catalog/governance/:itemId route-visible queue, review-plan, repair-boundary, and confirmed-action copy to English and Simplified Chinese message ids, added localized route tests, ran Admin Web gates, and completed desktop/mobile Chinese browser smoke.

Migrated /items/:itemId, /items/:itemId/artwork, and /automation/generated-artifacts/:artifactId/review route-visible detail, artwork confirmation, review-plan, boundary, and mutation-result copy to English and Simplified Chinese message ids, added localized route tests, ran Admin Web gates, and completed desktop/mobile Chinese browser smoke.

Audited residual Admin Web V2 hard-coded route copy, migrated /jobs, /playback/sessions, and /storage/staging table-route copy to English and Simplified Chinese message ids, added localized route tests, ran Admin Web gates, and completed desktop/mobile Chinese browser smoke.

Migrated /catalog, /acquisition/intake, and /automation/generated-artifacts queue/list route copy to English and Simplified Chinese message ids, added localized route tests, ran Admin Web gates, and completed desktop/mobile Chinese browser smoke.
Migrated /addons route-visible copy to English and Simplified Chinese message ids, added localized route tests, ran Admin Web gates, and completed desktop/mobile Chinese browser smoke.

continue_policy.notes: Lane complete. Continue the broader Admin Web V2 goal with users/permissions/Library Access or open a separate follow-on if future route-visible i18n work appears. LegacyDashboard hard-coded English remains legacy scope, not V2 route-local closeout. Keep addon ids, versions, permission strings, hosted-page ids, protocol values, token prefixes, health/status payloads, API enum values, ids, timestamps, file names, provider keys, generated-artifact names, and diagnostic facts stable.
